plain: To choose not to do something, such as not voting.

webster.text: In a general sense, to forbear, or refrain from, voluntarily; but used chiefly to denote a restraint upon the passions or appetites; to refrain from indulgence.

example.quote: An effectual expedient for this purpose will be, mutually, to abstain from those objects which either side may have first had recourse to.
